propositions: A single monolithic test function iterates over 884 renderable units with ~1768 pandoc spawns, executing in 91.6s idle but exceeding 300s timeout under CPU contention (504.8s), causing pytest-timeout's thread method to kill the xdist worker without traceback on macOS
The per-test cost is unbounded and load-dependent; macOS runner contention makes the timeout breach routine there while other platforms remain unaffected
Replacing the monolithic loop with chunk-parametrization (fixed 40-unit batches, ~23 test cases at ~4.2s each) bounds cost by construction and distributes work across xdist workers
All 884 units must remain compared against the oracle with real pandoc and stride 1, preserving byte-identity guarantee without timeout increase, retry marker, or elapsed-time assertions
A coverage guard test must verify all chunks reassemble to exactly 884 units and total >= 100 to prevent silent unit drops during parametrization
